_about: Hoard advisor rules (/tools/hoard/, F-25): what to save for which goal and why, without dates. Targets the cards don't give are the player's own (pending).

rules.text: Save your first AP recovery items for Lohar's Trial: it is a priority event for free players.

evidence.A11-0505: is a priority F2P event; save the first AP potion(s) for it

rules.text: Barbarian kills there pay out gems and arrows.
Save gems and spend them during More Than Gems, a 2-day event with daily gem-spend milestones (skip it below VIP 6).

evidence.A11-0502: More Than Gems (2-day event with daily gem-spend milestones) is the best window for F2P to spend gems (except below VIP 6)
evidence.A04-0009: ideally be spent during the 'More Than Gems' event for bonus rewards

rules.text: Reported free-player tier: 7,000 gems a day for 5 universal legendary sculptures.

goals.title: Eve of the Crusade and KvK

rules.text: Save AP recovery items above all for Eve of the Crusade: its marauders drop speedups, gems and credits.

evidence.A09-0007: especially the pre-KvK Eve of the Crusade (marauders drop speedups, gems, credits)

rules.text: Save speedups and resources as items for scored events and KvK healing, instead of spending them as they come.

evidence.A11-0501: save speedups, resources (as items), AP potions for scoring events and KvK healing

rules.text: Save for the milestone rewards, not for the ranking: ranking is out of reach for most free players in a new kingdom.

evidence.A11-0500: target individual milestone rewards (or coordinate with kingdom MGE rules)

general.text: Where universal speedups should go (research, City Hall, or the hoard) is divided: sources disagree.

evidence.A02-0503: One source says use universal speedups only on research; an older one says pour speedups into City Hall; others say hoard them.

general.text: There is no fixed event schedule: watch the in-game calendar, which shows upcoming events a few days ahead.

evidence.A11-0512: Events in RoK do not follow a fixed schedule; the calendar shows upcoming events a few days ahead

general.text: Hoard AP items, not regenerating AP: AP that sits at its cap is wasted.

evidence.A09-0007: idle AP at cap is wasted
